question: Should WorkIQ be delivered as a ClawHub package, and what licensing and identity/token contract may it use across the MXC boundary?
rationale: The repository has generic ClawHub and MXC foundations but no accepted WorkIQ ownership, licensing model, or security-sensitive token design.

options.title: Define Package Contract
options.body: Sponsor a ClawHub package with explicit licensing, token issuer and audience, consent, storage, refresh, revocation, and containment requirements before implementation.

options.title: Wait For Identity Design
options.body: Keep this dependency open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw-windows-node/issues/849 establishes a reusable Entra/WAM identity contract.

options.title: Decline Integration
options.body: Document WorkIQ as outside the supported roadmap if a compliant licensing and token contract cannot be established.

recommendation.title: Define Package Contract
recommendation.body: Sponsor a ClawHub package with explicit licensing, token issuer and audience, consent, storage, refresh, revocation, and containment requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They created and organize the WorkIQ item, MXC epic, and identity dependency, giving them the strongest available product-direction context.
